name: The Vanderson Family Grave
source:
The Vanderson Family Grave is the story of an unlucky hostage who wakes up with amnesia. While staying with the Vandersons, a wealthy (and somewhat eccentric) family that spans across four generations, can she recover her memories and help with the household troubles?

[From [url=https://anmeichan.tumblr.com/post/101397527170/i-challenged-myself-to-make-something-in-a-month]The official site[/url]]
translation:
《范德森家族之墓》讲述了一名倒霉的人质醒来后失去记忆的故事。寄居在跨越四代、富有而又有些古怪的范德森家族期间，她能否找回记忆，并解决家中的麻烦？

[摘自[url=https://anmeichan.tumblr.com/post/101397527170/i-challenged-myself-to-make-something-in-a-month]官方网站[/url]]
